name: 読書の達成と学習プロフィール
prompt:
Create a faithful Japanese 390 × 740 px learning-profile component. Reference 1 is authoritative for layout, exact text and visible badge crop. References 2–4 are the original achievement badge rasters; Reference 5 is the exact streak-flame artwork. Return only this component, with no phone frame or surrounding app page.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep the entire canvas and every card/surface pure white #FFFFFF. The badge rasters contain pale cream square mattes and pale-gray disk fills; replace those background fields with pure white while preserving the original circle outlines, gray medal artwork, question marks and blue progress arcs. The day selector is white with thin neutral-gray outlines, except the current Thursday selection, which is solid forest green #047857 with a white label. Keep the flame’s original orange/yellow as illustration artwork. The recommendation surface must be white with a thin neutral #E4E4E4 outline, not mint. Add no cream, mint, blush, pale-green or other tinted fill, gradient, glow, shadow or texture.

Match the exact 390×740 native layout. Top heading at x=16/y=8, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, #1D1D1D, “学習プロフィール”. Achievement heading x=16/y=84, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, “これまでの達成”. Below, keep a clipped horizontal row: three 168×168 badge images at y=134, with x positions -88, 96 and 280. Preserve original left/right clipping. Replace the warm square mat and pale-gray disk backgrounds with white; retain all neutral-gray medal motifs and the blue progress arc. Labels at y=310 in Meiryo Regular 12/16, #1D1D1D: x=0 width168 “一週間の学び”; x=96 width168 “二週間の学び”; x=280 width94 “説明する力”.

Streak card x=16/y=364, 358×302, white fill, 14 px corners, 1 px #E4E4E4 outline. Place the exact supplied orange/yellow flame at x=156/y=390, 79×119; preserve aspect ratio and colors. Heading x=32/y=530, 326×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, #1D1D1D, “1日間の連続学習”. Supporting text x=32/y=574, 326×16, Meiryo Regular 12/16, #6E6E6E, “毎日学んで、記録を伸ばしましょう”.

Seven weekday circles at y=616, each 28×28 and spaced 16 px apart, x=44, 88, 132, 176, 220, 264, 308. Labels centered at y=622, Meiryo Regular 12/16: “日”, “月”, “火”, “水”, “木”, “金”, “土”. All circles are white with a thin neutral #E4E4E4 outline and gray labels, except Thursday x=220: solid #047857 circle with a white “木”. No pale colored fills.

Recommendation row x=8/y=680, 374×48, white with a 1 px #E4E4E4 outline and 8 px corners. Text x=24/y=694, 342×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, #1D1D1D, exact copy “さいころで次に読む要約を選ぶ”. Keep the compact hierarchy, spacing, and all text exact. No additional content.
reviewNotes: White surfaces and solid green selected weekday; exact flame and badge art fidelity is unresolved, so one correction will target source-media preservation.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
